topicName: the fall of the roman republic

steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Gracchi brothers (Tiberius d.133 BC, Gaius d.121 BC) tried to reform land distribution; both were killed by senatorial opposition | Key Fact: Marius reformed the army: soldiers swore loyalty to their general (not the state), giving ambitious commanders private armies | Key Fact: Sulla marched his army on Rome (88 BC) — the first time a Roman general used military force against the city itself | Key Fact: The First Triumvirate (60 BC): Caesar, Pompey and Crassus dominated politics; it was an unofficial power-sharing agreement

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from the fall of the roman republic, and one past-paper question.
